subject: Request: Post-period coverage acknowledgement & bridge letter for SentryWave
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@sentrywave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sentrywave.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Post-period coverage acknowledgement & bridge letter for SentryWave

Hi Soojin,

We completed our vendor review for Redwood and were hoping to get a short bridge letter / post-period coverage acknowledgement that covers the gap between the SOC 2 Type II report end date (2026-07-31) and today. Our security team requires confirmation that there have been no material changes to the control environment since the report period ended, or — if there were changes — a brief description and remediation timeline.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
- A bridge letter signed by an authorized Redwood contact attesting to continuity from 2026-08-01 to present;
- Any supporting evidence (controls matrix, recent network diagram, or a whiteboard summary of change windows);
- An expected turnaround / approximate date for delivery.

We may need a version we can attach to our procurement record; if possible please include contact details for a security reviewer at Redwood.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
SentryWave

Attachments: none

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@sentrywave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Post-period coverage acknowledgement & bridge letter for SentryWave

Alex —

Thanks for the note and the clear ask. We can provide a bridge letter covering the period 2026-08-01 through today (we typically call this a "post-period continuity letter"). A few quick details so we can scope delivery:

1) Level of assertion: do you need a statement of "no material changes" to our control environment, or are you amenable to an "affirmation of controls in place" plus a short list of changes (if any)?
2) Evidence pack: we can include a controls matrix, a current network diagram, and a recent SOC-related runbook excerpt. Are those acceptable?
3) Signer: legal typically signs these. I'm looping in Laura from Legal to advise on wording and to sign.

Proposed timeline: we can draft the letter and a short evidence bundle within 3 business days once we confirm the wording you prefer. If you need a faster turnaround we can prioritize — let us know your deadline.

I will attach a draft of the bridge wording in my next message for quick review.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@sentrywave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sentrywave.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Post-period coverage acknowledgement & bridge letter for SentryWave

Thanks Soojin —

Our security team prefers an explicit "no material changes" statement if feasible; that speeds internal review. The evidence bundle you listed sounds perfect. We would like the documents uploaded to our vendor portal or sent via DocuSign/secure link so we can attach them to the record.

Deadline: would you be able to get the draft to us by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-03)? If not, EOD Thursday is our fallback.

Appreciate the quick help.

Best,
Alex

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@sentrywave.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Draft: Post-period continuity affirmation (Redwood) — for review

Alex / team —

Attached is a draft post-period continuity affirmation and a lightweight evidence bundle for SentryWave:
- SentryWave_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (the original report)
- controls-matrix.xlsx (snapshot of key control owners and last-tested dates)
- network-diagram.png (current logical diagram)

Draft excerpt: "Redwood Inference affirms that, to the best of its knowledge, there have been no material changes to the control environment affecting the scope of the SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2026-07-31, for the period 2026-08-01 through 2026-11-02. This affirmation is based on internal control reviews, change-control logs, and security monitoring during the post-period window."

Laura from Legal — can you advise if this language is OK to sign as-is or if you recommend alternate phrasing?

Alex — if the above looks good, we can finalize and route for signature (DocuSign) the same day. If you want additional detail (e.g., list of patch windows or a short summary of configuration changes) we can add an annex.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SentryWave_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf; controls-matrix.xlsx; network-diagram.png
